red_herrings.why_suspicious: He really did revise the master schedule at 3:42 PM.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: The revision history shows only the opening remarks moved; Orbit stayed at 4:00 PM and Nova at 4:10 PM, so it cannot explain the 4:30 PM paper.

red_herrings.why_suspicious: He operated the shared print desk.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: The print job ran under the ANAIR account, the photograph shows Aanya at the tray, and his shift ended at 4:05 PM with no record linking him to the altered page.

red_herrings.why_suspicious: She was the one who arrived late carrying the odd invitation.
red_herrings.innocent_explanation: The system shows the QR resolving to the original registration with no second registration, and the email she was sent said 4:00 PM; her photograph proves only what she received.
